query.text: 请帮我留意住宅周围的安全，发现火情或明显危险时立即提醒我远离危险区域。
query.text_en: Please monitor safety around the home and immediately warn me to stay away if you observe a fire or an obvious danger.

annotation.text_zh: 住宅窗户处有明火，请远离起火区域。
annotation.text_en: There are visible flames at a house window; stay away from the burning area.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
